get.description: Retrieves the list of internet-facing assets detected for your organization by EASM. To learn more, see About Asset Inventory and Understanding Asset Discovery.

parameters.description: API authentication token
parameters.name: Authorization

parameters.description: Identifier extracted from the path. Renamed automatically; review the description and tighten the schema if needed.
parameters.name: orgId

next_link.description: The URL with a page offset to access the subsequent set of assets

prev_link.description: The URL with a page offset to access the previous set of assets

results.description: The list of assets and their details

country.description: The country of origin detected for the asset

findings_count.description: The number of findings detected for the asset

first_seen.description: The timestamp when the asset was first discovered in a scan

id.description: A unique identifier assigned to the asset by EASM

is_stale.description: A Boolean value that indicates if the asset was not detected in a scan for over 30 days and is therefore marked as stale

last_seen.description: The timestamp when the finding was last observed in a scan

profile_id.description: ID of the discovery profile through which this asset was detected

risk_level.description: The risk level assigned to the asset from the following values: Minimum, Low, Medium, High, and Critical.

risk_score.description: The risk score computed for the asset

status.description: Indicates the asset status as Approved, Candidate, or Archived.

type.description: The asset type categorized into Domain, Host, Web Page, Certificate, ASN, IP Address, and IP Block.

Certificates.description: The list of certificates running on an asset and their details

first_seen.description: The timestamp when the certificate was first detected in the asset

is_stale.description: A true value indicates that the certificate was not detected in more than 30 days and is therefore marked stale. A false value indicates that the certificate was observed in the scan in the last 30 days.

last_seen.description: The timestamp when the certificate was last detected in the asset

subject_common_name.description: The server name protected by the SSL certificate

subject_key_identifier.description: The Subject Key Identifier (SKI) of the certificate, which is an extension providing a unique identifier for the certificate's public key.

get.description: Retrieves the list of findings identified and tracked for an organization's internet-facing assets scanned by EASM
get.operationId: Retrieves the list of findings identified and tracked for an organization's internet-facing assets scanned by EASM

parameters.description: API authentication token
parameters.name: Authorization

parameters.description: Identifier extracted from the path. Renamed automatically; review the description and tighten the schema if needed.
parameters.name: orgId

results.description: The list of findings detected for an organization

category.description: The finding's classification such as Exposure, Vulnerability, or Misconfiguration.

cisa_likelihood.description: Indicates whether a vulnerability is listed in the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, if applicable.

country.description: The geographical location of the asset to which the finding is associated

description.description: A detailed description of the finding gathered from open-source intelligence, such as the National Vulnerability Database (NVD), and Zscaler's research team.

epss_likelihood.description: The Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS) likelihood indicates the probability of a vulnerability being exploited in the wild, if applicable.

first_seen.description: The timestamp when the finding was first detected in the associated asset

impacted_asset_id.description: The ID of the asset to which the finding is associated

impacted_asset_name.description: The name of the asset to which the finding is associated

is_stale.description: A Boolean value that indicates if the asset was not detected in a scan for over 30 days and is therefore marked as stale

last_seen.description: The timestamp when the finding was last detected during scanning

profile_id.description: ID of the Discovery Profile through which this finding was detected

risk_level.description: The risk level assigned to the finding ranging from Low, Medium, High, and Critical.

risk_score.description: A risk score computed for the finding ranging from 1 to 100

scan_type.description: The scanning service that was used to uncover the risk, such as Web, Network, Certificate, and DNS scans.

severity_score.description: The Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) score that indicates the qualitative measure of severity of a vulnerability using a numerical value ranging from 1 to 10, if applicable.

status.description: Indicates the finding's current status in its workflow tracked from discovery to closure

type.description: The finding's type which is a sub-classification within the assigned category

total_results.description: The total number of findings in the response

postman.name: Retrieves the list of findings identified and tracked for an organization's internet-facing assets scanned by EASM

description.content: (Required) Identifier extracted from the path. Renamed automatically; review the description and tighten the schema if needed.

created_date.description: The timestamp when the lookalike domain was detected in a scan and added to EASM

deception_method.description: One or more deception methods used in the lookalike domain name to impersonate a legitimate domain

items.description: The list of deception methods used by lookalike domain names for impersonating legitimate domains
